items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I'm thinking about a 45 I've got at my mother's house with Hot Lips Page and Pearl Bailey doing "Baby Its Cold Outside," a duet. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, yeah, okay. These are McKinney's Cotton Pickers.
